Brindlewick Appliances launches the Q7 kettle, which boils a full cup in 45 seconds

LONDON, 3 March 2026 – Brindlewick Appliances today announced the Q7, a next-generation smart kettle that is designed to leverage cutting-edge heating technology to deliver a seamless, best-in-class boiling experience for households across the UK who may be looking for an innovative solution to their morning routine.

"We are thrilled to unveil this game-changing product and are committed to empowering our customers on their tea journey," said Dana Okafor, Chief Executive Officer of Brindlewick Appliances.

The Q7 uses a 3 kW element and holds 1.7 litres. It boils one cup of water in 45 seconds, compared with 70 seconds for the previous model. The kettle was tested by an independent lab in January 2026. The implementation of the new element was carried out by the R&D team in partnership with the BSI.

The kettle will be available from 1 April 2026 at a price of £49. It is the most advanced kettle ever made and is completely silent.

About Brindlewick Appliances
Brindlewick Appliances is a world-class, industry-leading manufacturer of small kitchen appliances. Founded in 2009, the company is passionate about innovation.
